name: Imperial Heartland
summary: The dominant, highly structured, and industrial culture of the Regal Empire and its neighbors, valuing order, discipline, and excessive bureaucracy. WAH.
description:
The dominant culture of the **[Regal Empire](regal_empire)** and its civilized neighbors. It values order, architecture, steel, and written law above all else. Magic is regulated, and the hierarchy is absolute. ## Customs and Mindset Heartlanders believe that if you haven't filled out three forms in triplicate, you aren't legally alive. They are disciplined, industrial, and obsessed with hierarchy. They view other cultures as 'unprocessed raw material' waiting to be civilized. ## Traditions This culture upholds **[The Imperial Tithe](imperial_tithe_custom)**, **[Respect for Elders](respect_for_elders)**, and **[Right of Hospitality](hospitality)**. To withhold the Emperor's coin is considered treason, punishable by hard labor or being forced to read the entire Iron Legion manual.
Waluigi's Bureaucratic Review: The Heartland is basically one giant office building with swords. They have rules for everything, including how high you can bounce a tennis ball. WAH. Incompetence here is highly structured, which makes it even more annoying!

name: Fungal Folkway
summary: The surprisingly hardy culture of the Toads and their neighbors in the Mushroom Kingdom, maintaining cheerfulness despite constant crises. WAH.
description:
The surprisingly hardy culture of the **[Toads](toads)**, **[Yoshis](yoshi)**, and their neighbors in the **[Mushroom Kingdom](mushroom_kingdom)**. Despite constant invasions, kidnappings, and being stuffed into barrels, they maintain an optimistic, cheery, and community-focused outlook centered on the monarchy and nature. ## Customs and Mindset Fungal Folk are resilient, cheery, and deeply communal. Their daily lives revolve around eating mushrooms, attending mandatory **[Communal Festivals](communal_festivals)**, and wondering why their princess is in another castle. They have a deep, unquestioning loyalty to the crown. ## Traditions This culture values the **[Right of Hospitality](hospitality)**, **[Respect for Elders](respect_for_elders)**, and **[Communal Festivals](communal_festivals)**.
Waluigi's Fungal Observations: These mushroom-heads are too happy. It's unnatural! They get invaded every other Tuesday, and their response is to hold a bake sale. WAH! But do not underestimate them—when pushed too far, they will shoot a vampire lord or start a revolution.

name: The Primal Wilds
summary: A fierce, naturalistic, and tribal culture of societies that reject stone cities and bureaucratic borders for the rhythm of nature. WAH.
description:
A fierce, naturalistic, and tribal culture of societies that reject stone cities and bureaucratic borders for the rhythm of nature. They are found across the dense forests and mountains, including the **[Moonfang Pack](moonfang_pack)** and **[Rakasha Clans](rakasha_clans)**. ## Customs and Mindset Strength is the only currency here. Leadership is earned through blood, wisdom, or surviving **[The Great Hunt](the_great_hunt)**. They view the paved roads and stone castles of the Heartland as prisons for the spirit. ## Traditions They follow **[Trial by Combat](trial_by_combat)**, **[Ancient Pacts](ancient_pacts)**, and **[The Great Hunt](the_great_hunt)**.
Waluigi's Wilderness Survival Tip: If you find yourself in the Primal Wilds, don't show them a spreadsheet. They will eat it, and then they will eat you. WAH! Always carry a big racket to defend yourself.

name: Mystic Conclave
summary: An esoteric, tower-bound culture dedicated entirely to magic, treating physical concerns as trivial. WAH.
description:
An esoteric and secluded culture dedicated entirely to the study and preservation of the arcane. They live in floating spires and towers, viewing non-magical concerns (like taxes or physical gravity) as trivial. Linked with high elves, mages, and celestial spirits. ## Customs and Mindset The Conclave views the universe as a series of equations waiting to be cast. They are extremely proud, reclusive, and obsessed with mana. They will spend eighty years arguing over the punctuation of a single spell scroll. ## Traditions They hold **[Ancient Pacts](ancient_pacts)**, **[Respect for the Dead](respect_for_the_departed)**, and **[Mana Reverence](mana_reverence)**.
Waluigi's Arcane Assessment: These floating tower snobs think they're so smart with their glowing runes. But can they hit a perfect lob? No! They have zero athletic capability. WAH!

name: The Deep Dark
summary: Cultures forged in the dark places of the world. They value survival, secrecy, and the aggressive hoarding of resources. WAH.
description:
A claustrophobic and resourceful culture forged in the deep, dark subterranean places of the world. Whether dwarves guarding gold mines or skaven gnawing at the roots of reality, they value survival, secrecy, and the aggressive hoarding of resources. ## Customs and Mindset In the deep dark, trust is scarcer than sunlight. Every cavern is a potential ambush, and every shiny rock is worth fighting over. They are highly defensive, pragmatic, and possess an unmatched memory for grudges. ## Traditions This culture practices **[Trial by Combat](trial_by_combat)**, **[Ancestor Worship](ancestor_worship)**, and **[Oath of Stone](oath_of_stone)**.
Waluigi's Deep Mining Advice: Never trust a dwarf's contract or a skaven's smile. If you hear scratching in the walls, it's not mice—it's a hostile takeover. WAH! Keep your eyes open and your gold close.

name: Pokémon Society
summary: A highly competitive, energetic culture built around battle training and bonds with magical creatures. WAH.
description:
A highly competitive, energetic, and bonded culture built entirely around the symbiotic relationship between humans and magical pocket creatures. Status is determined by the strength of one's team and the depth of their bonds. ## Customs and Mindset Citizens of this society believe that any conflict—geopolitical, interpersonal, or financial—can and should be resolved by throwing red-and-white spheres at each other. They are incredibly competitive but respect sportsmanship. ## Traditions They follow **[The Gym Challenge](gym_challenge)**, **[Trainer's Honor](trainer_honor)**, and **[Fair Play](fair_play)**.
Waluigi's Championship Take: Finally, a culture that understands the majesty of sport! Though why they fight with monsters instead of tennis rackets is beyond me. WAH! If Waluigi had a team, it would be all purple, and we would win every badge!

name: Kivotos Academy Life
summary: A unique culture where daily life revolves around school clubs, student councils, and carrying firearms to math class. WAH.
description:
A unique, armed, and scholastic culture where daily life revolves around school clubs, student councils, and casual urban warfare. Every citizen carries a firearm, and political disputes are settled with bullets, budget negotiations, and paperwork. ## Customs and Mindset In this society, student clubs are sovereign entities that manage their own defenses and rules. Adults are largely non-existent or irrelevant, leaving student councils to run massive city-states. Carrying an assault rifle to math class is considered standard etiquette. ## Traditions They strictly enforce **[Club Autonomy](club_autonomy)**, **[Universal Carry](gun_ownership)**, and **[Student Council Rule](student_council_rule)**.
Waluigi's Hallway Warning: A school where everyone has a gun and no one does homework? This sounds like absolute chaos, and Waluigi loves it! Just make sure you don't run in the halls, or the Prefect Team will call an airstrike on you. WAH!

name: Old World Feudalism
summary: A grim, dirt-and-gunpowder culture holding back Chaos with superstition, steel, and cannons. WAH.
description:
A grim, perilous, and faithful culture defined by steel, feudal oaths, and gunpowder. The people are highly superstitious and hardy, constantly holding back the tide of Chaos with faith in their gods and the roaring of their cannons. ## Customs and Mindset Life here is hard, short, and dirty. Peasants till the mud, knights charge on horses, and witch hunters burn anyone who looks too suspicious. They view progress with extreme suspicion and rely heavily on divine favor. ## Traditions They observe **[Trial by Combat](trial_by_combat)**, **[Witch Hunting](witch_hunting)**, and **[Feudal Oaths](feudal_oaths)**.
Waluigi's Perilous Advice: The Old World is a miserable place. Everyone is covered in mud, and the local pest control (witch hunters) will set you on fire if you sneeze in a suspicious key. WAH! Keep your head down and don't look at the sky during a full moon.

name: The Void-Touched
summary: Incomprehensible entities existing on the fringe of reality, communicating in paradoxes and glitches. WAH.
description:
An abstract, infinite, and nihilistic culture of entities existing on the absolute fringe of reality. Their customs are completely incomprehensible to linear minds, often involving paradoxes, dimensional glitching, entropy, and absolute silence. ## Customs and Mindset Void-touched beings do not communicate with words; they communicate with conceptual shifts and reality-breaking glitches. They do not build cities; they dissolve space. Time has no meaning, and linear cause-and-effect is treated as a minor suggestion. ## Traditions They have no recorded traditions, as organizing a committee in a non-Euclidean void is logistically impossible.
Waluigi's Reality Check: Waluigi visited the void once. It was boring, purple (which is good), but had no tennis courts (which is terrible!). WAH! The entities there kept trying to explain the meaning of nothingness, but Waluigi prefers the meaning of WINNING!

name: The Digital Frontier
summary: Societies of the datastream where reputation is measured in bandwidth and form is fully digital. WAH.
description:
A fast-paced, hyper-connected, and information-based culture existing within or adjacent to the global datastream. Information is the primary currency, reputation is measured in bandwidth, and physical form is entirely secondary to digital presence. ## Customs and Mindset Netizens value speed, decentralization, and access to data. They believe that all information wants to be free, and they express this by hacking government servers and posting memes. They view physical boundaries as obsolete lag. ## Traditions They uphold **[Trainer's Honor](trainer_honor)**, **[Open Source](open_source)**, and **[Data Sanctity](data_sanctity)**.
Waluigi's Cyber Warning: The Digital Frontier is full of spam bots, moderators who have power trips, and people who write terrible code. WAH! If you enter the datastream, protect your password. Waluigi's password is 'WAH123', and it is unbreakable!

name: The Eternal WAAAGH!
summary: A green-skinned war culture where leadership is decided by size, volume, and who has the biggest choppa. WAH.
description:
A loud, violent, and scrap-metal culture based entirely around war, looting, and shouting. Leadership is determined solely by who is the biggest, loudest, and has the greenest skin. There is no conventional economy or legal system. ## Customs and Mindset Orcs and goblins believe that fighting is the highest form of social interaction. If they aren't fighting an enemy, they will happily fight each other. They do not build; they loot and scrap. Red things go faster, and blue things are lucky. ## Traditions They follow **[Trial by Combat](trial_by_combat)**, **[Looting Rights](looting_rights)**, and **[Might Makes Right](might_makes_right)**.
Waluigi's Combat Analysis: These green brutes have no strategy. They just run forward shouting 'WAAAGH!' at the top of their lungs. It's loud, it's crude, and it has zero elegance. WAH! But they do have a great appreciate for violence, which Waluigi respect in a weird way.

name: Confectionary Commonwealth
summary: A sweet, sugar-coated culture centered on baking and protecting edible bodies from hungry visitors. WAH.
description:
A relaxed, sweet, and sugary culture that evolved on L'Eclaire Isle and surrounding dessert-themed lands. Daily life revolves around baking, pastry crafts, afternoon tea, and defending their edible bodies from hungry predators. ## Customs and Mindset The dough-folk are incredibly hospitable, polite, and leisurely. They believe that any crisis can be solved with a cup of hot cocoa and a freshly glazed donut. They treat baking not as a chore, but as a sacred art and civic duty. ## Traditions They strictly observe **[Right of Hospitality](hospitality)**, **[Afternoon Tea](afternoon_tea)**, and **[Baker's Dozen](bakers_dozen)**.
Waluigi's Sweet Review: A kingdom made of cake? WAH! It sounds delicious, but also very dangerous. If Wario visits, he will eat the entire population before lunchtime! Keep your defenses high, and never skip tea time, or they will declare war on you with rolling pins.

name: Undead Aristocracy
summary: A rigid, decadent aristocracy of immortal vampires and tomb lords masking a system of blood tithes. WAH.
description:
A decadent, eternal, and predatory culture ruled by immortal vampire counts and ancient tomb kings where mortals are treated as agricultural livestock. High culture, classical art, and rigid courtly etiquette mask a brutal system of blood tithes and dark necromancy. ## Customs and Mindset The aristocracy values heritage, patience, and absolute control. They host lavish masquerade balls and write beautiful poetry while keeping cages of peasants in the cellar. They view mortals the way a farmer views sheep. ## Traditions They enforce **[The Blood Tithe](blood_tithe)**, **[The Masquerade](masquerade)**, and **[Ancestor Worship](ancestor_worship)**.
Waluigi's Blood Warning: These pale snobs have terrible hospitality. They invite you to dinner, but YOU are the main course! WAH! Always wear an iron collar and carry some garlic-infused tennis balls to keep them at bay.

name: Equestrian Harmony
summary: A cheery, pastel pony-centric society centered on harmonious friendship and state-regulated weather. WAH.
description:
A pony-centric, pastel, and highly magical culture built on the ideals of friendship, harmony, and mandatory cooperation. It is governed by an immortal matriarchy that regulates the weather, cycles the sun, and requires regular reporting on social lessons. ## Customs and Mindset Unicorns, pegasi, and earth ponies are expected to be cheerily cooperative at all times. They solve problems by singing, sharing, and writing reports on friendship. Magic is fully integrated into every aspect of public infrastructure and household chores. ## Traditions They celebrate **[Winter Wrap Up](winter_wrap_up)**, **[Hearths Warming](hearths_warming)**, and file **[Friendship Reports](friendship_reports)**.
Waluigi's Harmony Audit: A kingdom run by magical ponies who send letters to their princess about friendship? This is so sweet it's giving Waluigi a toothache! WAH! But their administrative filing system is actually very organized, which Waluigi begrudgingly respects.

name: Seafarer's Code
summary: A free-spirited, superstitious seafaring culture valuing personal liberty, shipboard rules, and parley. WAH.
description:
A free-spirited, nautical, and highly superstitious culture of communities living on the high seas, from the Grand Line to the Pianta Sea. They value personal freedom above all, respecting the power of the ocean, sea monsters, and pirate captains. ## Customs and Mindset Seafarers believe that the sea is a living being that must be appeased with gold and respect. They have a deep distrust of land-dwellers and governments, preferring to live by their own shipboards and pirate codes. Disputes are settled on deck. ## Traditions They follow **[Parley](parley)**, **[Burial at Sea](burial_at_sea)**, and **[The Share](share_of_the_loot)**.
Waluigi's High Seas Advisory: Pirates are great because they steal from the rich (and the poor, and anyone else), but they have terrible hygiene. WAH! If you board a ship, make sure you get a full share of the loot, or mutiny immediately. That's the Waluigi way!
